title: EEG: RL Task (3-Armed Bandit) with alcohol cues in hazardous drinkers and ctls
description: EEG recordings from a three-armed bandit reinforcement learning task in which alcohol-related and non-alcohol beverage cues were presented to 53 community participants, including hazardous drinkers and controls. The dataset supports investigation of electrophysiological markers of cue-specific exploration in hazardous drinking. This derivative version was processed with the NEMAR pipeline.
methods_description: Data were collected between 2019 and 2021 at the CRCL at UNM while participants performed a 3-armed bandit reinforcement learning task with alcohol versus beverage cues. Triggers and outputs are documented in the BEH_EXPLAIN.m file in the code folder.
